description: This file defines the Download model class for the Opencart admin system, handling CRUD operations for download records in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving downloads and their descriptions and reports.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Model class managing download entries, descriptions, and reports within the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: addDownload
methods.description: Creates a new download record in the database and adds descriptions for multiple languages.

methods.name: editDownload
methods.description: Updates an existing download record and replaces its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteDownload
methods.description: Deletes a download and all related descriptions and reports from the database.

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Retrieves a specific download record including its description for the current language.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Retrieves multiple download records based on optional filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Returns the total count of download records matching optional filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a new description entry for a specific download in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific download.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions in the database for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all description records for a download, grouped by language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all description records associated with a particular language.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Returns download report entries, such as IP address and access date, for a specific download.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Removes all reports related to a download.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Fetches the total number of reports for a specific download.
